Schnittstelle Monadic<WT extends org.quurz.foomp.higher.WitnessType, A>

Typparameter:
WT - the witness type of the implementing higher‑kinded type
A - the carried value type
Alle Superschnittstellen:
Appliable<WT,A>, Bindable<WT,A>, Mappable<WT,A>
Alle bekannten Unterschnittstellen:
Eval<A>, Maybe<A>, Provider<A>
Alle bekannten Implementierungsklassen:
Attempt, Box, Eval.Always, Eval.Later, Eval.Now, Maybe.None, Maybe.Some, Task
public interface Monadic<WT extends org.quurz.foomp.higher.WitnessType, A> extends Mappable<WT,A>, Appliable<WT,A>, Bindable<WT,A>

Rank‑1 monad‑like interface that combines the contracts of Mappable, Appliable and Bindable. Implementations support mapping, applicative application (applying a function inside the context), and monadic flatMap (monadic bind) over the carried value while preserving the constructor shape.

Contract: transformation functions must not be null and should not return null; implementations should return non‑null results and keep the higher‑kinded constructor (witness) consistent.

1.0.0
